source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: The Organizer draws up a timetable, makes it available to all competitors before the competition, and is responsible for adhering to it so that individual events neither start more than thirty minutes early nor run more than thirty minutes late.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must hold a published timetable per event with planned times, project and warn on lateness (monitoring), flag a proposed change that would breach the thirty-minute limits as a preventable scheduling violation requiring acknowledgment and reason, and record actual start times. Never automatically assess any penalty.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Blocked on a time model (planned start and duration per floor heat, event time zone, actual start timestamps); planned times are not authored today.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED and a blocker to activating an NDCA profile. The text does not define 'event' for this limit (DanceFlow division, round or floor heat?), so the mapping needs an owner interpretation (Q2). No NDCA timetable adherence exists in DanceFlow.
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
